title: Guidepoint Repositions from Expert Network to AI-Powered Expert Insights
summary: Guidepoint announced a strategic repositioning of its global business, reframing itself from an expert network into a provider of AI-powered access to real-time expert insights. The company described an integrated stack spanning live expert consultations, on-demand content through the Guidepoint Library, AI-enabled synthesis, and integration tools including APIs and an MCP server. Guidepoint cites access to 2,000,000+ experts across 300+ industries and 150 countries.
whyItMatters: A top-five incumbent explicitly rebranding around AI-enabled access — rather than expert calls alone — confirms that the category's positioning language is shifting industry-wide toward integrated research platforms.
